annotations.title: Write a voice agent from the brand

description: Hermoso's AI writes a phone voice agent from the brand profile (business facts, products, tone, FAQs): its instructions, first line, end-of-call and voicemail lines, what a successful call is, and the facts to pull from each call. purpose is the job (e.g. 'answer calls and book a demo'), direction inbound or outbound. Nothing is created; create_voice_agent takes the result. Costs a few credits. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.
